newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Q1 1997 GDP rose 2.4 pct year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Danish Q1 1997 GDP rose 2.4 pct year-on-year.

text.p: Denmark's Gross National Product grew by 2.4 percent in the first quarter of 1997 compared to the same period in 1996, the National Statistics Office said on Monday.
Compared to the last quarter of 1996 GDP shrank by 0.1 per cent, the office said.
It revised its figure for full-year 1996 year-on-year GDP to growth to 2.7 per cent from a previous 2.4 percent.
Economists polled by Reuters had, on average, forecast first quarter 1997 year-on-year growth of 3.4 percent.
